```{r}
    library(networkdata)
    library(igraph)
    g <- flo_marriage
    A <- as.matrix(as_adjacency_matrix(g))
```


```{r}
    jaccard.dist <- function(z) {
        p <- z %*% z
        q <- z %*% (1 - z) 
        r <- t(q)
        return(1 - (p / (p + q + r)))
        }
```

```{r}
    W <- jaccard.dist(A)
    s <- eigen(W)$vectors[, 1]
```
